paragraphs.text: The Echoverse Arc is the one-year storyline that follows the Dragonstorm Arc . It is the final part of a three-year story arc codenamed Metronome . It consists of the premier sets Edge of Eternities , Lorwyn Eclipsed , Secrets of Strixhaven , and Reality Fracture .

The Echoverse Arc started in August 2025 and features the following sets: Edge of Eternities , Lorwyn Eclipsed , Secrets of Strixhaven , and Reality Fracture . While not containing story elements, Alchemy: Edge of Eternities and Alchemy: Lorwyn are also set within the Echoverse Arc.

Edge of Eternities is relatively disconnected from the other stories in the arc, focusing instead on establishing the new setting of the Edge and the characters therein. The other sets focus on five Strixhaven students: Abigale , Kirol , Sanar , the transfer student Lluwen , and the enigmatic Tamira , as mysterious anomalies threaten the stability of Arcavios and the Multiverse at large. This leads to the reveal of the Echoverse in Reality Fracture .
